instruction: Please describe the typical visual characteristics of nuclei observed in an H&E stained colon tissue slide at 40x magnification. Focus on providing concise English phrases that capture the nuclei's geometric shape, staining color, and relative size.
format_hint:
Answer with exactly two short noun phrases, one per line, nothing else. Each phrase must end with the word 'nuclei' and combine shape, colour and size, in the form:
<size> <shape> <colour> nuclei
<size> <shape> <colour> nuclei
